title: Changed the `colWidths` array and function to address columns by their physical index, so a column keeps its width when the user moves it, and when you insert or remove columns. Handsontable never changes the array you pass. Switching `colWidths` to or from an array, or passing a new array, clears the undo history. See the 18.1 to 19.0 migration guide to keep the old behavior.
